about.title: Body builders first, since 2012
about.text: Nanak Fabricators Ltd. was established and registered in 2012 at Khim Business Park, Athi River, by the late Hon. Jaswant Singh Matharu. The company is now run by his son, Parminder Singh (Pami), and has built a strong reputation in tippers, trailers, fuel and water tankers, exhausters and custom bodies on all makes of cars and trucks. We fabricate the body, straighten the chassis, beat the panels and finish the paint in one workshop — nothing is sent out and nothing leaves before it is right.

items.title: in-house fabrication
items.text: Cutting, folding, welding, panel beating and paint all happen under our roof. Nothing is subcontracted and nothing leaves half-finished.

items.title: measured, not guessed
items.text: We measure the chassis and the load before we draw the body, so the deck height, wheel clearance and weight distribution are right the first time.

items.title: a finish that lasts
items.text: Steel is prepared and primed properly before paint. That is why our bodies still look straight after years of loading and washdowns.

items.title: a timeline you can plan around
items.text: You get a build sequence and a handover date with the quote. We tell you early if a part or a chassis change moves it.

items.title: insurance-ready repairs
items.text: Accident work is documented stage by stage, with photos and a clear scope, so assessors and fleet owners see exactly what was done.

items.title: after-sales support
items.text: Hoists, hinges, latches and paint are all ours to stand behind. Bring the unit back and we will put it right.

label: [ FAQ ]
title: questions & answers
text: The questions we are asked most often. If yours is not here, call the workshop — we would rather talk it through than guess.
imageAlt: A tipper body being assembled at the Nanak workshop

general.q: how do I get a quote?
general.a: Send us the chassis make and model, the body you need and the load you carry. If you can, bring the vehicle to Athi River so we can measure it. We will come back with a scope, a price and a build date.

general.q: how long does a body take to build?
general.a: A pickup or small drop-side body is usually a matter of days once the chassis is here. A tipper or tanker takes longer, and a coach body longer still. We agree the sequence and handover date with the quote.

general.q: can you build on a chassis I already own?
general.a: Yes. Most of our work is on customer chassis, new or used. We inspect the frame first and tell you if it needs straightening, shortening or extending before a body goes on.

general.q: do you handle insurance accident repairs?
general.a: Yes. We repair accident-damaged cars, pickups, trucks and buses for both insurers and private owners, and document each stage with photographs for the assessor.

general.q: do you supply parts and fittings?
general.a: We supply the hoists, hinges, latches, lighting and paint we use on our own bodies, and we can source chassis-specific parts for a repair. Ask us with the chassis number.

work.q: which body should I choose for my chassis?
work.a: It depends on the load and the routes. Tell us what you carry, how heavy it is and where it goes, and we will recommend a body and a deck height that keeps the truck legal and stable.

work.q: can you match my fleet colours?
work.a: Yes. We mix and match two-pack paint to your fleet colour or a sample panel, and finish lettering, stripes and hazard markings in-house.

work.q: do you convert prime movers into tippers?
work.a: Yes. We fit the hoist, hydraulic tank and pipework, reinforce the frame where needed, and build the tipper body around the existing chassis.

work.q: how is the body fixed to the chassis?
work.a: With a braced sub-frame and properly rated mounts, not direct-to-frame welds. That keeps the body serviceable and avoids cracking the chassis rails.

work.q: can I see a unit before I commit?
work.a: Come to Athi River. There is usually a body in fabrication and finished units in the yard, and we will walk you through the joints, the finish and the fittings.

beliefs.title: what we believe
beliefs.imageAlt: Aerial view of the Nanak Fabricators yard with completed trucks

items.title: the body is part of the truck
items.text: A body is not a box dropped onto a chassis. Weight, deck height, mounts and frame strength are engineering decisions, and we make them before we cut steel.

items.title: finish is not a coat of paint
items.text: Preparation is most of the work: bare metal cleaned, seams sealed, panels blocked flat, then primed and painted. The shine is the last five percent.

items.title: one workshop, one signature
items.text: Fabrication, panel work, paint and fit-out all happen here. When one team owns the whole job, nothing gets lost between suppliers.

repair.label: [ Accident repair ]
repair.title: Straightened, beaten and painted in-house
repair.text: Accident repair is the other half of the workshop. Cabs are stripped, pulled and straightened on the frame, panels are beaten or replaced, and the repair is primed, blocked and painted to a matched finish. Every stage is photographed so insurers and owners can see what was done under the paint.

sections.title: 1.  About Nanak Fabricators Limited
body: Nanak Fabricators Limited is a vehicle body fabrication, panel beating, spray painting and accident repair workshop based at Khim Business Park, Mombasa Road, Athi River, Kenya. These terms apply to quotations, orders, repairs and any work carried out by us.

sections.title: 2.  Quotations and orders
body: A quotation is valid for thirty days unless stated otherwise. An order is confirmed when you accept the quotation in writing and pay the agreed deposit. Changes to the scope, chassis or specification may change the price and the delivery date.

sections.title: 3.  Lead times
body: Lead times are given in good faith and depend on the specification, parts availability and the condition of the chassis. We will tell you as soon as we know a date has moved.

sections.title: 4.  Deposits and payment
body: A deposit is required before fabrication begins. The balance is payable before collection unless credit terms have been agreed in writing. Vehicles may be retained until outstanding amounts are settled.

sections.title: 5.  Vehicle storage and collection
body: Vehicles are stored at our yard at the owner's risk. Please collect within seven days of being told the work is complete; storage after that may be charged.

sections.title: 6.  Warranty
body: We stand behind our fabrication and paint work. Warranty periods and exclusions are stated on the quotation or invoice. Wear items, accident damage after handover, and work carried out by others are not covered.

sections.title: 7.  Insurance repairs
body: For insurance work we repair to the scope approved by the assessor. Additional damage found after stripping is reported before extra work proceeds. The policyholder remains responsible for any excess or unapproved amount.

sections.title: 8.  Intellectual property
body: Drawings, photographs and specifications we produce remain our property. You may not reproduce them for another fabricator without written permission.

sections.title: 9.  Liability
body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the value of the work carried out. We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, including loss of earnings while a vehicle is off the road.

sections.title: 10.  Privacy
body: We use the contact details you give us to quote, carry out and follow up on your work. We do not sell your details. Ask us if you want your information removed.
